items.q: The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who saw eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing to him in a dream.
The father of our master Yusuf ﵇, also a Blessed Prophet ﵇.
Our master Yusuf's ﵇ brothers threw him into this.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who spoke with Allah and is called "Kalim Allah".
The brother of our master Musa ﵇ who helped him.
The tyrant king who claimed to be a god in the time of our master Musa ﵇.
Our master Musa's ﵇ staff turned into this.
Our master Musa ﵇ struck the sea and it did this.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ given the Zabur.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who understood the speech of birds and ants.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ swallowed by a great fish.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ known for great patience in illness.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ born without a father.
The mother of our master 'Isa ﵇.
Our master 'Isa ﵇ spoke as a baby in this.
The old Blessed Prophet ﵇ who prayed for a son and was given our master Yahya ﵇.
The son of our master Zakariyya ﵇.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ sent to Madyan, who told his people to give full measure.
The bird that brought news of the Queen of Saba' to our master Sulayman ﵇.
The one who killed Jalut in battle.
Our master Yusuf's ﵇ brothers brought back his shirt stained with this.
Our master Yusuf ﵇ was sold for a few of these coins.
The title of the official in Egypt who bought our master Yusuf ﵇.
Our master Yusuf ﵇ chose this over doing wrong.
The king of Egypt in the time of our master Yusuf ﵇ dreamt of seven fat cows eaten by seven of these.
Our master Yusuf ﵇ asked to be put in charge of this.
Our master Ya'qub ﵇ regained his sight when this was cast over his face.
Our master Musa's ﵇ mother put him in a box on this river.
The wife of Fir'awn who adopted our master Musa ﵇ and believed, named in the reports.
Our master Musa ﵇ fled to this land and worked there for years.
Our master Musa ﵇ first saw this on the mountain and went toward it.
Our master Musa ﵇ was told to take off these in the sacred valley.
The sacred valley where Allah spoke to our master Musa ﵇.
The man who made the golden calf.
The food sent down to the Children of Isra'il in the desert.
The number of springs that gushed from the rock when our master Musa ﵇ struck it.
The rich man of our master Musa's ﵇ people who was swallowed by the earth.
Our master Dawud ﵇ was taught to make this from iron.
The Queen of Saba', named in the reports.
Our master Yunus ﵇ prayed from the darkness, "There is no god but You, glory be to You..." (meaning), in this surah.
The number of our master Yusuf's ﵇ brothers, counted from his dream.
The brother of our master Yusuf ﵇ kept back in Egypt, named in the reports.
Our master Yusuf ﵇ had this put in his brother's bag.
Our master Ya'qub ﵇ said this kind of patience is best.
The women cut their hands when they saw our master Yusuf ﵇ because they were cutting this.
The number of signs (ayat) given to our master Musa ﵇, in Surah al-Isra'.
Besides the staff, Musa's ﵇ other main sign: his hand came out like this.
Fir'awn's minister, named in the Qur'an.
The believing man of Fir'awn's family who hid his faith; the surah is also named after him.
Our master Musa ﵇ asked Allah to untie this from his tongue.
Our master Musa ﵇ was given the Tawrah after this many nights on the mountain.
The people told to slaughter a cow, which gave the surah al-Baqarah its name.
The wise servant whom our master Musa ﵇ followed to learn.
Al-Khidr ﵇ made a hole in a boat, killed a boy and did this.
The king of the Children of Isra'il chosen by Allah, under whom our master Dawud ﵇ fought.
Our master Sulayman ﵇ was given control of this, which blew by his command.
The death of our master Sulayman ﵇ was only found out when a creature ate this.
Our master Ayyub ﵇ was told to strike the ground with this, and water came out.
Our master 'Isa ﵇ made birds from clay and they flew, by this.
The disciples of our master 'Isa ﵇ are called this in the Qur'an.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ whose people were the only ones to believe in time and be saved from punishment.
Our master Yunus ﵇ was cast onto the shore and Allah grew this plant over him.
Our master Yunus ﵇ was sent to more than this many people.
Our master Yunus ﵇ is called this, "the companion of the fish" (meaning).
The Blessed Prophet mentioned among the patient in Surah al-Anbiya', with Isma'il and Idris ﵉.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ sent to people who worshipped the idol Ba'l.
The Blessed Prophet named with Isma'il and Dhul-Kifl ﵉ in Surah Sad.
Our master Dawud ﵇ was judged on the case of two disputants who climbed over this.
items.a: The wall of his prayer room (mihrab)

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said the most beloved fasting to Allah was the fast of this Blessed Prophet ﵇ (paraphrased).
items.a: Our master Dawud ﵇, fasting every other day

items.q: Our master Dawud ﵇ ate only from this, as our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said (paraphrased).
items.a: The work of his own hands

items.q: The throne of the Queen of Saba' was brought to our master Sulayman ﵇ in this short time by one with knowledge of the Book.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who inherited from our master Dawud ﵇.
The Queen of Saba' and her people worshipped this.
The palace floor of our master Sulayman ﵇ was made of this, so it looked like water.
Our master Shu'ayb's ﵇ people were destroyed on "the day of the shadow", in this surah (meaning).
The people of our master Shu'ayb ﵇ are called this, "the people of the thicket" (meaning).
Our master Zakariyya ﵇ was given a sign of not speaking for this many days.
Our master Zakariyya ﵇ found this with our lady Maryam ﵍ whenever he entered her prayer room.
Allah says our master 'Isa ﵇ was not killed or this.
The surah named after the table sent down at the request of the disciples of our master 'Isa ﵇.
Our master Yusuf ﵇ stayed in prison for "some years", the word used is this.
The two young men in prison with our master Yusuf ﵇ dreamt of pressing grapes and of carrying this on the head.
Our master Yusuf ﵇ raised his parents on this when they came to Egypt.
Our master Ya'qub ﵇ is also called this name.
Our master Musa ﵇ killed an Egyptian by mistake with this.
A man came running from the far end of the city to warn our master Musa ﵇ that the chiefs were plotting to do this.
Our master Musa ﵇ agreed to work for eight years, or this many if he chose.
The daughter in Madyan said the best to hire is one who is strong and this.
The plagues sent on Fir'awn's people include flood, locusts, lice, frogs and this.
The sorcerers of Fir'awn believed and he threatened to cut off their hands and feet and do this.
The place where Musa and al-Khidr ﵉ met, "the meeting of the two seas" (meaning).
Our master Musa ﵇ lost this, which was the sign of where our master al-Khidr ﵇ would be.
The servant who travelled with our master Musa ﵇, named in the hadith.
The Children of Isra'il wandered for this many years.
Talut tested his army at this.
The jinn worked for our master Sulayman ﵇ making these, as large as reservoirs.
Our master Sulayman ﵇ was given a spring of this metal.
Our master 'Isa ﵇ gave good news of a Messenger after him named this.
Our lady Maryam ﵍ was told to shake the trunk of this.
The surah in which our lady Maryam ﵍ is called "sister of Harun".
